test_dense_linearization: test the DenseLinearization class by verifying its A, b, AtA, and Atb matrices match expected values
create_dense_linearization: create a DenseLinearization instance from an objective and variable ordering using theseus
run_linearize_method: run the linearize method on a DenseLinearization object to compute Jacobian and residual matrices
review_dense_linearization_class: review the DenseLinearization class and its linearize method for correctness of AtA and Atb computation
summarize_test_dense_linearization: summarize the test_dense_linearization function that validates DenseLinearization output against a reference linear system
